Argentina Advances to World Cup Semifinals After Victory Over Switzerland

Argentina has reached the semifinals of the FIFA World Cup 2026 after defeating Switzerland in a quarterfinal match. The game saw a red card for a Swiss player and went into extra time, with Argentina ultimately winning 3-1. Key goals were scored by Alexis Mac Allister and Julian Alvarez, with Lionel Messi also contributing to the team's performance and setting historical records.
